rules.rule: An input (%I) tag is written by a coil or a box output.
A %I or %Q address is declared that is not in the specification I/O table.
A rung that is not a header (only horizontal wires or empty cells) has no coil and no box that writes an output pin.
A physical output (%Q) tag is driven by SET or RESET coils (outputs must be decided by an OUT coil every scan).
